system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
Abstract: “{abstract}”
Methods: “{methods}”
The dataset can be found at {filepath}.
system_prompt_style.note: Initial user prompt is a template with study variables; per-agent role system messages are free-text descriptions. Paper-only; quote spans a line break in the extracted figure text.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: the initial prompt included manually selected variables from the NACC data dictionary relevant for replicating the study (typically 15–30 columns per study, depending on complexity)
env_context_strategy.note: Data-dictionary context injected up front plus agents exploring data via executed code; closest values mixed (injected context + agent-driven navigation). Paper-only.

context_compaction.note: Only a paper was available; no config surface or history-processing code in the evidence.

observation_format.evidence_quote: react to stimuli and code outputs, correct error code
observation_format.note: Code execution output fed back to the conversation; paper-only.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Executor - a special non-LLM agent which executes Python code passed from the Engineer.
tool_call_format.note: Engineer writes Python code blocks executed by the Executor agent.

tool_count.note: No tool list in the evidence; code execution happens via an executor agent, not declared function schemas.

edit_primitive.note: No tool registry in the paper-only evidence.

protocol_standardization.note: No dependency list or source available; paper silent on protocols.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: a special agent which orchestrates the team, chooses speakers, and broadcasts speaker responses to other agents to track cumulative actions and responses.
loop_primitives.note: Group-chat manager selects next speaker and broadcasts messages; closest mapping react plus broadcast (event_driven). Planner/critic interplay also resembles plan_execute.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Planner - suggests and revises a plan for the agent team to follow based on instructions from the user.
planning_granularity.note: Plan exists only as conversation text from Planner agent; no stored plan object described.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: an agent ”manager” is declared, which facilitates agent-to- agent communication and chooses the next appropriate agent as ”speaker”
multi_agent_topology.note: AutoGen GroupChat with manager and 5 role agents; closest value; could also be read as peer. Quote contains original hyphenation.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
Determines next speaker,
broadcasts conversation
to other agents

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: We enabled the agents to seek user approval at key decision points to keep the user in the loop and ensure transparency.
human_in_loop.note: Admin/user approves plans and completion requests.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Critic - critiques the plan and provides feedback for improvement.
self_verification.note: Critic is another role of the same model (GPT-4o).

retry_policy.note: Single attempt per study reported but no task-retry mechanism place in evidence.

termination_condition.note: Paper mentions agents seeking approval to complete; no termination config available.

execution_isolation.note: Executor environment (local vs Docker) not described.

tracing.evidence_quote: transcripts of LLM agent responses, actions and code are available

eval_hooks.note: Evaluation done manually per paper Sec. 3.4.

target_domain.evidence_quote: tasked with writing and executing code to dynamically reproduce the findings of each study

open_source.note: Repo URL given but footnote says code released on acceptance; no LICENSE in evidence.

model_agnostic.note: Only GPT-4o used; AutoGen abstraction not evidenced.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Code will be made available upon article acceptance

first_release_date.note: Fallback to paper v1 date; no tag/commit info.

pinned_version.note: No tag or commit in evidence; paper cites Autogen version 2.

stars.note: gh api result not in evidence.
